milestones.title: Shared load & controller tracking
milestones.scope: Measure throughput at 16 / 64 / 256 parallel environments under shared load; check tracking with the same controller.
milestones.acceptance: Record measured throughput and controller tracking before selecting the rollout configuration.
milestones.result_note: Complete with a declared FD limitation: 16 / 64 / 256 environments measured 877.744721 / 3,393.919703 / 12,829.080117 env-steps/s; per-world sim/wall was 0.45715873 / 0.44191665 / 0.41761331. All use the same frozen N03/HSM GPU PhysX + Fabric rigid-body workload, 100 warmup + 1000 timed-prefix steps, no render, one shared-load run each. This is not completed tasks/s. Valid 4 / 16 / 64-env process peaks were 4,931 MiB; 256-env peak was 5,061 MiB with 10,002 MiB minimum free and no guard stop. A fixed-overhead model replaced the earlier proportional overestimate, followed by staged measurements. The failed 1-env initialization (0 native steps) remains retained and is excluded from the model. B1 actual tracking passed across 16 Panda worlds: worst position RMS/max 4.1217 / 6.0730 mm and orientation RMS/max 0.81688° / 1.25805°; command and actual speed/acceleration exceedances were 0. Acceleration limiting affected 50,142/403,200 joint-steps (12.4%); speed limiting was 0. The clock recorded 3,600 callbacks / 30.000001565 native s, wall 529.614 s. The original full local FD gate remains false at far-origin x≈22 / 30 m in float32, alongside the independently passed tracking diagnostic; all three earlier failures remain retained.

milestones.scope: Start with N03 / N12. Each expert must resume from the current observed state rather than depend on a one-way script.
milestones.acceptance: Centered 4×4 task domain: pass a native TCP Jacobian preflight at the same thresholds first; then 20 nominal episodes and 50 real mid-trajectory rollout-state takeover tests per task. State-driven experts must match prior nominal success before takeover.

milestones.result_note: Measurements closed with limitations. Both candidate-2 nominal runs are 20/20. N03 takeover: 50/50 (proxy 25/25; random 25/25), with 3/3 verified regrasp-and-task successes among genuine grasp-interruption opportunities. N12 takeover: 44/50 (proxy 25/25; random 19/25); all six unrecoverable failures remain in the denominator. Observed N12 grasp-interruption opportunities: 14; sampled subsequent regrasp plus task success: 7/14. Six tasks failed; one more task completed without sampled regrasp evidence. Two prefix-unsafe cases remain in the full denominator. This opportunity definition does not cover every possible failure or disturbance. Already done at takeover: 0 for both tasks. Each 50-episode set reuses 20 source scenes; this is not 50 independent-task generalization trials. N12 strict local safety is NOT_ALL_PASSED: case09 recorded one actual-acceleration exceedance above the 15.0001 rad/s² local threshold, and case49 one command-acceleration exceedance above 2.51 rad/s². High-rate peak magnitudes and exact ticks are unavailable. The 46,000 / 41,811 geometry-feasibility candidates for N03 / N12 are not training admissions or evidence that every safety gate passed. Qualification-role data remain outside training, with 0 qualification buffer rows and 0 qualification parameter updates. Separate new training-role data and BC20 fits are reported under Mc. Candidate 1’s N03 0/20 remains retained.

New training-role collections for N03 and N12 each completed 20/20 expert episodes on the fixed new 20-instance bank: 14,000 queried = 14,000 admitted, with all four local velocity/acceleration exceedance counters at 0. The accepted training buffer contains 28,000 rows; no qualification rows were used. Each single-task BC20 calibration pilot completed 4,000 CPU updates (4 threads, seed 20261031). Final full training-set losses: N03 0.006171051; N12 0.006140919. Final model tensors and training-only normalization checks passed. These are calibration fits, not formal M1–M4 training, whose update count remains 0. Student zero-query native rollout acceptance, native student closed-loop evaluation and N17/N18 training-data acceptance remain unmeasured. CPU component checks (policy 4; data 19) remain supporting evidence, not a substitute for native acceptance.

disclosures: This page describes the approved phase-2 plan and a dated local evidence summary.
A completed expert reliability measurement does not establish learned-policy performance, recovery capability or a phase-2 milestone pass.
No OPD learning curves or policy success scores have been measured in this snapshot.

Qualification nominal task success and measurement integrity are separate from training admission. Earlier qualification nominal traces lack raw per-tick verifier evidence; training admission is 0. Four data-boundary regressions do not establish task-level verifier acceptance.
Ma and Mb measurement reports are closed with declared limitations; N12 strict local safety did not pass every local gate.
Both task takeover sets use 50 episodes from 20 source scenes. Their Wilson intervals are descriptive episode intervals, not independent-task generalization evidence.
Only three N03 cases met the independent grasp-interruption opportunity definition; recovery was 3/3 in those cases, not 50 recovery trials.

N12 had 14 observed grasp-interruption opportunities: 7 subsequent sampled regrasp-and-task successes, 6 failed tasks and 1 task completion without sampled regrasp evidence. Two prefix-unsafe cases remain in the full denominator; this observation-based definition is not exhaustive fault coverage.
Qualification datasets remain outside training. Separate new training-role collections contribute 28,000 accepted labels; the two BC20 calibration fits performed 4,000 CPU updates each.
BC20 losses are measured on admitted training samples only. They do not establish native student task success, shifted robustness or formal M1–M4 performance; formal method training updates remain 0.
